value.rationale: A complete all-rate phase diagram of phase-space negativity with two distinct topology-changing physical parameter paths and an explicit angular-average blind spot is a natural, motivated quantum nonclassicality characterization. It predicts where Wigner measurements reveal local negative patches and when radial observables conceal them. The thresholds are sharp and not arbitrarily chosen slices; no claim of a general full-oscillator theorem is made.
